about_p2: Every photograph on this site is our own work, and it covers generators and backup power, lighting installation, conduit, meters and exterior work. 25 customers have left us a review, averaging 4.8 out of 5. We work out of Dunn and the towns around it.

reviews_h2: Straight from the people who called us

reviews.author: Mark Wilson
reviews.text: Dustin just installed a whole house standby generator. We are very pleased with the installation and look forward to many years of excellent service. Thanks.

reviews.author: Chad LIbecap
reviews.text: Parker’s electric is the most reliable electrical service you will find in the area. I own multiple rental properties and I’ve used Parker’s electric for many years. They are very responsive, fair pricing, and they will not try and upsell you on anything. Highly recommend them for any project or problem.

reviews.author: Joey Toler
reviews.text: My son introduced me to Dustin when I needed an electrician. Dustin and his crew came over and handled all my electrical issues and I couldn’t be more pleased! Great team! Very professional and friendly!
